summary: This bill establishes an interagency task force to combat domestic child human trafficking, mandates a study on the issue, and creates several grant programs for schools, foster care agencies, law enforcement, job training, and long-term care facilities to prevent trafficking, identify victims, and provide support services.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes an interagency task force and grant programs aimed at combating child human trafficking, which involves law enforcement training, victim identification, and pre-trial diversion programs for victims. It focuses on a victim-centered approach, including non-judicial rehabilitation services and policies not to prosecute victims, which leans towards softer justice and rehabilitation within the context of human trafficking.
